title: Hooke's law for the spring
caption: Extension is proportional to force up to the limit of proportionality, so F against x is a straight line through the origin whose gradient is the stiffness k = 2.0/4 cm = 50 N m⁻¹ (0.5 N per cm). Then 5.0 N stretches it 10 cm.
alt: Graph of force in newtons against extension in centimetres: a straight line through the origin passing through (4, 2.0) and (10, 5.0).
description: The horizontal axis is the extension x in cm; the vertical axis is the force F in N.
The line passes through the origin and the measured point (4 cm, 2.0 N): its gradient is k = 50 N m⁻¹.
Reading across at 5.0 N gives x = 5.0/50 = 10 cm, as long as the spring stays inside its limit.
